proof.name: Lean 4, leanchecker and leanexport
proof.trusted: Type theory, the pinned kernel/imported logical basis, and checked formal definitions. The distribution itself is not asserted to be a verified machine-code prover.

proof.name: nanoda
proof.trusted: Independent Rust kernel checks exported declaration terms under the registered axioms. Its runtime and ISA remain in the trusted base.

runtime.name: CPython
runtime.boundary: Actual interpreter and script identities are measured. Scoped source lifts use explicitly recognized semantics.

runtime.name: Go
runtime.boundary: Build options and actual executable digest are observed. General compiler preservation is outside the sealed Go source claims.

runtime.name: jsonschema / referencing
runtime.version: versions and artifact hashes in uv.lock
runtime.boundary: Offline Draft 2020-12 validation under the explicitly registered dialect, resources and format checkers.

runtime.name: SQLite
runtime.version: runtime version recorded by the actual fixture
runtime.boundary: Durable SQLite transaction semantics, storage honoring synchronous commits and single-writer ownership.

runtime.name: OpenSSL
runtime.version: observer runtime version in each dossier
runtime.boundary: Cryptographic signature and TLS implementations under the configured trust anchors.

runtime.name: Kubernetes and K3s
runtime.boundary: Control-plane identity/RBAC, network and volume semantics. Cluster deployment, crash and real observations are checked separately.

runtime.name: Chromium and WebDriver
runtime.version: actual browser and driver in observation
runtime.boundary: Browser semantics and actual user-agent rendering, accessibility tree and keyboard navigation at named sizes.

rebuild.environment: UV_OFFLINE=true and GOPROXY=off after populating pinned packages and images.
rebuild.toolchain_details: Archive and executable/library SHA-256 for admitted verifier distributions are recorded in assurance/wire/toolchain.json; artifacts record the platform actually exercised.
